Definition: from a compound of the base of G4756 and G3004 (in its original sense); to gather (or select) as a warrior, i.e. enlist in the army:--choose to be a soldier.
BiblicalUsage: The word is choosing soldiers, enlisting them for the campaign. No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life, that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier. The choosing belongs to the commander, not to the recruit.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the choosing is the comfort: the Commander picks His soldiers, and the soldier's business is to please Him.
